A frozen Work request can survive physical interruption when its native journal, unit, preflight, request digest, and executor binding are reconstructed from remote authority before resume.
All child responses must be durably recorded before private reveal, and final judgments must remain deterministically recomputable from exact records.
A bounded unit PASS must remain separate from the still-FAIL user-level objective.
